info.title: KarryGo Commerce Analytics, Reporting and Reliability

post.description: Internal HMAC v2 endpoint for authoritative operational services. Signed caller must equal sourceService. Idempotent by eventId. Also accepts Dispatch-only dispatch.route.created.v1, dispatch.route.versioned.v1, dispatch.route.rerouted.v1 and dispatch.route_alert.opened.v1 envelopes from the existing Dispatch outbox. Route payload permits only route_version, state, policy_version, alert_type, severity, distance_bucket_km and duration_bucket_minutes; exact coordinates, provider and customer identities are rejected. These feed an independent route daily read model, not Vendor reliability. Unknown schema/event type fails closed; changed route event fingerprints conflict.

get.description: Operational decision-support report. Not audited accounting truth.
Versioned reliability score from measurable operational components. Not a star rating and not verification status.
